repair.diagnosis: Promo discount is calculated from only the first cart line's unit price instead of the whole cart subtotal
repair.evidenceSummary: Catalog: 12900+4900+3400=21200 subtotal; SAVE10=10% should give 2120 discount and 19080 total. Observed 19910 equals 21200-1290, i.e. 10% of only the 12900 Trail Runner Shoes first line.
repair.rationale: Using the already-computed subtotal (which sums price*qty for all lines) makes the promo apply to the whole mixed cart, yielding 21200-2120=19080 for the confirmed scenario.
